reason: Primary user-facing purpose is PDF document text extraction for AI workflows: the plugin exposes a model-facing `read_pdf` tool so agents can read and summarize PDF content. Evidence shows it is a DeepSeek Harness plugin using unpdf/PDF.js to extract plain text from PDF bytes and return structured page-based output with explicit size bounds and documented format/limitation constraints.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 `read_pdf` 工具，让 AI 模型在会话中读取并提取 PDF 文本内容，返回可用于摘要或分析的纯文本。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a `read_pdf` tool to DeepSeek Harness so AI models can read PDF files in-session and receive extracted plain text for summarization or analysis.

capabilities: Reads PDF files from workspace file systems
Extracts plain text from PDF content
Returns extracted text to an AI agent through a model-invoked tool
Applies file-size and output-length limits per call

reasons.code: README describes the plugin as a DeepSeek Harness add-on providing a `read_pdf` tool for PDF text extraction for AI agents/LLM tools.
README specifies the flow uses `ctx.fs.readBytes` with workspace/sandbox policy and enforces `maxFileBytes` and `maxOutputChars` to bound resource usage.
package.json defines a `dsh.bundle` entry and plugin metadata, indicating runtime integration as a harness profile plugin rather than a standalone UI service.
